notes.title: New patch: Stability & bug fixing
notes.content:
Hi players,

A new patch for EDENGATE: The Edge of Life is now available for download, which includes bug fixing and additional improvements.

Here’s the changelog:


General stability improvements
Framerate capped at 120 fps
Crash fix leaving Gallery

Thank you for your patience and your feedback!

HOOK Team

notes.title: Vote the EDENGATE’s soundtrack in the Steam Awards!
notes.content:
Hi Player,

During the Steam Autumn Sale, you can nominate EDENGATE: The Edge of Life for the Steam Awards category “Best Soundtrack”.

The OST of the game was composed by the talented Laryssa Okada, whom we can never thank enough for her lovely work!

[previewyoutube=6-jBPt8ylxI;full][/previewyoutube]

You can listen to the playlist here.

Thank you

- HOOK Team
